name: Serranillos del Valle (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Serranillos del Valle (a castle on yellow and green).
history: Municipal flag of Serranillos del Valle; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
